target_area: requirements: partner segregation and tenancy (alongside UNB-XIN-SAS-007)
proposed_change: Add a requirement for termination of a licensing/embedding channel partner of Echelon (vendor-side channel exit): the sponsor tenancy, data, branding and integrations continue under a direct Echelon licence or a successor partner without data migration and without the partner gating sponsor exports
rationale: Independence safeguard for DEC-001; current UNB-XIN-SAS-007 covers a sponsor-side distribution-partner exit only

proposed_change: Replace templated text with concrete channel-partner minimum terms (P3-DEC-FGJ003) and the component licensing policy (P3-DEC-FGJ001) once the owner decides
rationale: Sections are templated with no channel economics (P3-CLM-FGJ018)

proposed_change: Meter registry cost separately for public-intelligence maintenance and sponsor-specific eligibility decisions, and tag human work by operational event ID and work category (eliminated; automated; accelerated; transferred; deferred; mandatory)
rationale: Allows marginal sponsor cost and elimination claims to be measured rather than modelled
proposal_status: proposed - not submitted (another agent is editing Unbound)

proposed_change: State the sample-audit design as sponsor-configurable parameters (confidence; tolerable rate; acceptance number; strata) with defaults 95%/2%/0/three strata, and state that the audit detects systematic rates, not individual errors; a finding opens a root-cause case and does not automatically suspend renewal
rationale: Makes the audit sizable and auditable; avoids false-alarm-driven suspensions (26% at a true 0.2% rate)

target_area: Monitoring risk tiers within the 180-day ceiling
proposed_change: Define tier 1 (listed public charity; automated renewal), tier 2 (non-IRS evidence; 12-month expiry; automated request first), tier 3 (conflict; adverse history; sponsor-flagged; human review at least every 180 days) as FreshnessPolicy configuration; no tier may exceed the 180-day ceiling
rationale: Implements DEC-003 hybrid without loosening the ceiling

proposed_change: Add Census of Governments and NCES CCD as deterministic public-domain evidence sources for government units and school districts, bound by candidate links (no auto-merge)
rationale: Automates a measured first-time exception class (~0.5% of rows) once validated (P3-VAL-HI005)

proposed_change: Begin archival of IRS and sanctions releases before the registry is built (UNB-CNET-003 behaviour without the product), so replay evidence accumulates
rationale: IRS files overwrite history; evidence for V-3 cannot be recreated

proposed_change: Carry legacy charity verification evidence with valid, publication and recorded times and expiry into the package so Unbound reuses rather than re-vets every recipient at cutover; unknown publication time is treated as unpublished (UNB-CNET-001)
rationale: Avoids a cutover re-vetting spike; aligns with UNB-ONB-009/020

target_area: UNB-CDD-CIV-008 open question OD-CDD-02 (charity deep review); competitive-displacement-decisions 04 owner decisions
proposed_change: Record the economic consequence of OD-CDD-02 beside the open question: under the ratified deep review (registry M1) the one-sponsor registry run is about $768k a year at 20k charities against about $124k for the hybrid M5, and licensing break-even rises from about 3,949 to 10,963 accounts per customer (model revision 2); in revision 3 the consequence depends also on who performs the review: under licensing a sponsor-performed review is sponsor labour (break-even 3,079 accounts), while an Echelon-performed M1 review never breaks even (an on-demand vendor addition of about $469k a year for one sponsor at 20k charities); ask for the owner decisions before any licensing commitment (P3-DEC-MOD004, P3-DEC-MOD005; see P3-XRI-RECON005)
rationale: The requirement keeps the ratified wording until the owner decides; the decision now carries the largest single cost consequence in Phase III

target_area: Requirements TRN-REQ-MP-005/MP-007/MP-010 (package promotion, reuse metric, first vendor package) and the migration rehearsal plan
proposed_change: Record that Unbound's commercial economics now assume a first conversion of $75-325k with the first three customers per incumbent cluster at that rate and a 6-12 month go-live lag (P3-ASM-MOD042, P3-ASM-MOD043); measure hours per conversion and package reuse from the first rehearsal so the implementation rate after customer three can be evidenced rather than assumed
rationale: Later-customer implementation cost depends on vendor-package reuse that Transitus defers to phase 3; OD-P3-02 keeps Transitus outside the kill rule

target_area: Capital allocation record CAP-DAF-001 and business-plan funding sections
proposed_change: Record three owner inputs the model needs before a DAF cost center opens: the cost-center definition and whether the month-24 pilot clock also starts there (OD-P3-03, OD-P3-04, P3-DEC-MOD001); the owner's funding capacity against the cash at risk before the kill rule pauses ($1.33M for A from today, $1.38M for A3 in model revision 3; $1.46M and $1.81M in revision 2; P3-GAP-MOD001); and the build gate (P3-DEC-MOD003)
rationale: Model revision 2 finds no base-case payback; the owner's exposure is the cash spent before the first kill-rule test

target_area: CNV-PAY-001 role table and commercialization budget; UNB-CNET-006 subordinate roster refresh
